# Advocate Technologies

$1.3 Trillion in commercial real estate assets — from multi-family to office — are benchmarked on Advocate's real-time insurance market terminal. Brokers, loan servicers, and property owners use Advocate to organize policy data with AI Agents, benchmark coverage and pricing against live market transactions, and monitor portfolio risk continuously. 71,117 policies organized. $7.3B in premium benchmarked. 5,633 carriers in market.
